question: Should a client get a Field's id in the outputs it already receives, reversing RFC-039's retirement of the keyword, or through a separate name-to-id read?
statement: We will report each Field's id beside its name in the outputs clients already receive.

compass.settles: Not doing nothing: b2ff7c91 requires the identifier in these outputs. The Conformance cell (one way over many) favours A.
compass.leaves_open: Axis 5-11 prefers reliability. A reverses a standing statement, which its boundary clause allows only as explicit supersession at a declared boundary. Whether that reversal is worth it, and whether to add the lookup later, is your judgement.

stakes.changes: Clients get ids with no extra calls; srs-web regains its field option under Tell apart by. About 58 bytes per schema property.
stakes.forecloses: A lookup as the primary mechanism. Five srs-rust tests that assert the keyword's absence are inverted.
stakes.undo: Hard once third parties conform to it: removing the keyword would be a further supersession.
stakes.wrong_if: Most clients that need an id hold only a Record, with no schema or facet in hand.

options: Do nothing: clients see names only; srs-web keeps no field option; b2ff7c91 stays unmet in these outputs

options.action: A: id beside name in the authoring schema and facets
options.leads_to: one mechanism, no extra calls; RFC-039's retirement reversed by name

options.action: B: a separate (typeId, typeVersion, name) -> fieldId read plus facets listing contributing Types
options.leads_to: the schema stays id-free, closest to RFC-039; a second mechanism; one call per Type per view; a client must combine per-Type results itself

options.action: A now, with B's Record-only lookup later if an agent use case appears
options.leads_to: A's outcome with a second mechanism left open as a convenience

recommend: A: id beside name in the authoring schema and facets
why: One mechanism over two: B's facet rule still leaves the client calling once per Type and combining results, which is grouping logic in the client.

revisit.not_working: Agents keep reading a schema or running a find only to learn one field's id; then add the lookup.
revisit.done: srs-web restores Tell apart by with no client name matching.
